style: Shot as a MetaFlora News editorial photograph: hyperreal, full-frame camera, 85mm lens at f/2.8, eye level, 16:9. Low-key chiaroscuro lighting: one soft cool-white key light from the upper right, and the left 45% of the frame falls into deep indigo-black shadow (#0b0b14). A single thin rim light in violet color #a78bfa traces the back edge of the hero subject, the only saturated colour in the frame. Palette of near-black indigo, natural plant greens and warm wood. Matte tactile materials, fine film grain, calm premium restraint. Hero subject sharp in the right half. Every surface is plain, matte and unprinted.

items.name: dea-A
items.prompt: The glass front door of an empty medical dispensary at night, its brushed-steel handles bound by a heavy chain and padlock. Inside, one cannabis flower sits in a softly lit glass display case. The white dome of the U.S. Capitol is faintly reflected in the glass, softly blurred.

items.name: dea-B
items.prompt: A hand in a dark suit cuff, cropped at the wrist, presses a heavy steel embossing seal down onto a closed cream folder on a dark desk. Beside it a cannabis flower sits in a sealed glass vial. Through the window behind, the U.S. Capitol dome glows at dusk, out of focus.

items.name: cresco-A
items.prompt: A hyperreal macro of a precision steel bench vise gently compressing one large, dense cannabis flower on a dark slate retail counter, trichomes glistening. Beside it, three short stacks of plain coins step down in height from left to right.

items.name: cresco-B
items.prompt: Two hands, cropped at the wrist, slide a glass jar of cannabis flower across a dark walnut dispensary counter while one fingertip presses a single small steel coin onto the wood. Rows of identical glass jars glow softly on shelves behind, blurred.

items.name: germany-A
items.prompt: A dark oak apothecary cabinet with white porcelain jars. In the foreground a brass balance scale weighs cannabis flower, one pan tipped high and empty, and a few euro coins lie scattered on the counter beside it.

items.name: germany-B
items.prompt: Across a dark oak apothecary counter, one hand slides a blank white plastic card back toward another hand. Between them sit a small white tub of cannabis flower and a few euro coins. White porcelain apothecary jars are blurred behind.

items.name: nh-A
items.prompt: An empty legislative chamber at dusk: curved rows of dark wooden desks, one brass desk lamp lit over a thick stack of blank unprinted pages with a fountain pen and a pressed cannabis leaf resting on top. Through a tall window, a gilded state house dome glows against snow, blurred.

items.name: nh-B
items.prompt: Hands in rolled shirtsleeves, cropped at the wrist, hold a fountain pen over a thick stack of blank unprinted pages under a green-shaded banker's lamp, a pressed cannabis leaf on top. Through the tall window behind, a gilded state house dome in a snowy dusk, out of focus.

items.name: tribes-A
items.prompt: A long dark-wood council table at dusk. On the near side, a braid of sweetgrass and a potted flowering cannabis plant; the chairs on the far side are empty and pushed in. Open prairie glows through the tall window behind.

items.name: tribes-B
items.prompt: Weathered hands, cropped at the wrist, cradle a young cannabis seedling in dark soil inside a greenhouse on open prairie at dusk; across the wooden bench an empty chair faces them.

items.name: science-A
items.prompt: A dark ophthalmology exam room. A slit-lamp eye examination microscope with its steel chin rest in sharp focus; a single cannabis flower rests on the chin rest, beside a glass dropper vial of amber cannabis oil and a small dish of plain white capsules.

items.name: science-B
items.prompt: A figure sleeping out of focus under a dark linen duvet in a dim clinic sleep room. In the foreground on a bedside tray: a glass dropper vial of amber cannabis oil, a plain white eye-drop bottle and a dark sleep mask, lit by a faint monitor glow.
